about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Engineering Scalable Web & Mobile Products
bioParagraphs: I am a Software Developer with 3+ years of professional experience engineering production-grade web and mobile applications. I specialize in building scalable user interfaces, decoupled state architectures, and optimizing client-side performance.

Throughout my engineering tenure at Elixir Techne and client enterprises, I have spearheaded frontend initiatives from zero to production, optimizing network performance (cutting redundant API traffic by 25%) and establishing robust UI component standards using React 19, Next.js, TypeScript 5.8, and React Native.

pillars.title: Clean Architecture
pillars.description: Building modular, decoupled component systems with strict TypeScript typing and predictable state management.

pillars.title: Performance Optimization
pillars.description: Achieving sub-second page loads through aggressive code-splitting, lazy loading, bundle auditing, and smart client caching.

pillars.title: Cross-Platform Mobile
pillars.description: Engineering fluid iOS & Android mobile applications using React Native with 60 FPS animations and offline sync capabilities.

pillars.title: Enterprise Reliability
pillars.description: Implementing WCAG accessibility guidelines, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and bulletproof UI testing practices.

experienceSection.title: Work Experience
experienceSection.subtitle: 3+ years of hands-on frontend engineering in production environments

experiences.description: Leading frontend development for enterprise SaaS web applications and cross-platform mobile apps, owning feature architecture end-to-end.
responsibilities: Architected production-ready web platforms with React 19, Next.js, and TypeScript, delivering robust user interfaces under fast-paced deployment schedules.
Spearheaded state management & API caching optimizations using Zustand and TanStack Query, cutting redundant client-side network traffic by 25%.
Engineered enterprise dealer inventory mobile applications using React Native, implementing offline local database persistence and real-time REST API synchronization.
Containerized frontend development environments with Docker and set up automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, streamlining release reliability.
Established reusable UI design system primitives with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI, enforcing accessibility (WCAG) and uniform typography.

experiences.description: Architected a high-throughput B2B web application with complex data dashboards and automated build environments.
responsibilities: Led remote frontend architectural decisions and sprint execution, accelerating feature release cycles across distributed engineering teams.
Optimized bundle size and render paths using Vite 7 and code splitting, slashing initial page load times.
Autonomously built multi-tenant B2B client management dashboards with Tailwind CSS and custom component libraries.

experiences.description: Owned frontend optimization for multi-user coaching portals, enhancing user retention and interaction speeds.
responsibilities: Refactored state layer caching to reduce expensive API network traffic by 25%.
Boosted page performance scores by 20% through aggressive image optimization and dynamic component imports.
Translated complex product wireframes into production-ready UI components with weekly stakeholder demos.

experiences.description: Migrated legacy web applications to Next.js Server-Side Rendering (SSR) architectures.
responsibilities: Engineered Next.js SSR architecture to enhance page indexability and SEO rankings.
Configured granular code splitting and lazy loading boundaries to minimize initial JavaScript payloads.
Worked closely with backend engineers to integrate RESTful API contracts with strict TypeScript interfaces.

projects.title: Aegis Tracker
projects.subtitle: Privacy-First Productivity Extension (React 19)
projects.description: Engineered a privacy-centric Chrome Extension using React 19, Vite 7, and Recharts with 100% client-side local storage and smart idle detection.
projects.challenge: Productivity trackers frequently transmit sensitive user browsing activity to third-party servers, posing severe security and privacy risks.
projects.solution: Built a zero-backend browser extension that processes and visualizes user metrics entirely inside local browser storage, utilizing Chrome Extension API alarms and Recharts.
projects.results: Successfully deployed on Chrome Web Store, reaching 5,000+ active weekly users with zero external server dependencies.

projects.title: Heptaverse B2B Platform
projects.subtitle: Enterprise SaaS Platform Architecture
projects.description: Architected a production-ready B2B enterprise platform with complex data dashboards, Zustand state synchronization, and Docker containerization.
projects.challenge: Managing complex state across asynchronous enterprise workflow pipelines under tight release timelines without sacrificing UI responsiveness.
projects.solution: Implemented a modular React 19 architecture backed by Zustand micro-stores and TanStack Query for optimal request deduplication and client state separation.
projects.results: Cut initial bundle sizes by 30% and enabled zero-downtime automated deployment via Dockerized CI/CD pipelines.

projects.title: Jalsa Bitez
projects.subtitle: Luxury Cafe & Culinary Brand Web App
projects.description: Designed and engineered a high-end responsive culinary web app featuring bespoke keyframe animations and a particle-based HTML5 canvas loader.
projects.challenge: Creating a visual footprint that distinguishes a local boutique establishment from generic commercial chains.
projects.solution: Built custom keyframe animation sequences, radial ambient glow layers, an interactive canvas particle splash screen, and responsive partner integrations.
projects.results: Significantly elevated average session duration and reduced bounce rates through interactive visual craftsmanship.

projects.title: Empowering Fitness
projects.subtitle: Interactive Health & Fitness Platform
projects.description: Developed a feature-packed web application containing client-side interactive calculators (BMI, TDEE, BMR, Hydration) and dynamic timetable schedules.
projects.challenge: Fitness platforms struggle with high user drop-offs when static timetables and non-interactive marketing pages fail to engage potential members.
projects.solution: Engineered real-time client-side fitness metric calculators and tabbed weekly schedule filters built with glassmorphic layout panels.
projects.results: Drove a direct increase in client conversion rates and membership inquiry form submissions.
